name: Sam's Club Café Cheese Pizza Slice, Pizza Pretzel & All-Beef Hot Dog
brandOrRestaurant: Sam's Club Café (Logan, South Jordan & Nationwide)
whyItWorks: Budget-friendly food court staples; the quarter-pound Nathan's/Member's Mark all-beef hot dog on a white bun is dairy-free and low-fiber, while the Cheese Pizza and Pizza Pretzel work well on steady days with a Lactaid.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the All-Beef Hot Dog plain, or choose the Cheese Pizza / Cheese Pizza Pretzel (skipping pepperoni and the 4-Meat or Jalapeño slices).
watchOuts: Strictly avoid the Pepperoni & Jalapeño pizza slice
Take a Lactaid for pizza mozzarella
